trace.judge_rationale: The submitted candidate summary is empty or contains no substantive text. Therefore it provides no factual or interpretive content to judge against the source: faithfulness, concept coverage, and preservation of qualifiers all score 0.0 because none of the source’s concepts, examples, caveats, or claims are represented. Structure quality is 0.0 because there is nothing to organize or scan. The only positive is that an empty submission contains no filler or repetition, so no_fluff is scored 1.0. If a nonempty summary is provided, I can re-evaluate with detailed, source-grounded scoring.
